name: Current Transformer Bar Type
overview: Newtek Bar type current transformers are designed to be mounted in-line with bus bars, making them an integral part of power distribution systems. These CTs are fully insulated to withstand the high voltages present in switchgear applications. The construction of a bar type CT involves several key elements that contribute to its functionality and reliability.

The primary winding of a bar type current transformer consists of a single turn primary conductor, which is typically a fully insulated bar. The insulation on the primary winding conductor can either be a bakelized paper tube or a resin directly molded on the bar. This insulation ensures the safety and integrity of the primary winding in high voltage environments.

The secondary winding of a bar type CT is wound on a core, which is similar to other types of current transformers. The core is made up of laminated steel or other suitable materials to minimize magnetic losses. The secondary winding consists of multiple turns, and the number of turns is determined by the desired turns ratio.
benefits: Fully insulated design for safe operation in high voltage environments.
Accurate current measurement with low burden on the secondary winding.
Wide range of turns ratio options for precise current monitoring.
Robust construction to withstand short circuit forces and mechanical stresses.
Flexibility in installation and assembly, with options for on-site assembly.
Power distribution systems in commercial and industrial settings.
Electrical substations for accurate monitoring of current levels.
Power generation plants for reliable current measurement.
Renewable energy systems, such as solar and wind farms.
High voltage applications where insulation and safety are critical.

name: Control Transformer
overview: Control transformer designed to provide & maintain high degree secondary voltage stability during a short period of time on overload condition. Designed to meet the specific requirements of control applications, this transformer provides stable and regulated voltage to ensure smooth operation of control devices and equipment. Control Transformer, a reliable and efficient solution for powering control circuits in various electrical systems.

The Control Transformer is specifically designed to convert high-voltage power supply to a lower voltage level suitable for control circuits. With its compact size and versatile mounting options, it can be easily integrated into control panels and electrical enclosures.

Featuring robust construction and high-quality components, the Control Transformer delivers consistent and reliable performance even in demanding environments. Its insulation properties ensure safety and protection against electrical hazards.

When it comes to three-phase transformer connections, the Control Transformer offers flexibility to meet different electrical system requirements. With options for delta and star (wye) connections, it allows for seamless integration into three-phase systems, providing efficient power distribution and control.

Whether used in industrial automation, machinery control, or HVAC systems, the Control Transformer plays a crucial role in maintaining optimal control circuit performance. It provides a stable and regulated power supply, preventing voltage fluctuations and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of control signals.
